facts.fact: Smyg 开场：Kitty B 在主卧与意大利小鲜肉「doing sexing」，赶她走；她宣布 girl-crush bestie 之爱不变、自问「为什么坏事全找我」「人群中孤独」；强要故事下饭（amuse-moi）。
facts.anchor: I found my best pal, Kitty B, in the main bedroom, entangled with that young Italian spunkeroo

facts.fact: 故事一（被她自己判为 anecdote）：Edinburgh Gardens 途中小狗扑腿咬住他最爱的樱桃红羊毛衫把前面抽丝；失主本人只笑着说 How cute!——叙述者点评：可称 anecdote。
facts.anchor: it laddered the front of my jumper

facts.fact: 故事二「The Story of the First Date」：二十多岁被邻家妹安排约会其姐 Philomena（同龄，Carlton 住）；步行赴约途中被一只大狗淡定咬破大腿——为初吻约会新买的青柠绿棉裤报废、见血。
facts.anchor: it nonchalantly bit my thigh, tearing my brand-new lime-green cotton trousers, bought expressly for the first date, and drawing blood.

facts.fact: 狗主（四十上下）的法式辩护：Mr Rusty 是十四岁红毛爱尔兰雪达犬（超预期寿命）、老化致疯——咬人非攻击而是「误入歧途的深情」；求他别告 council（怕狗被处死）；狗是 nasty separation 后从 breeder 处购得、被当 second husband、睡她床上；Volvo 送医打破伤风针（医生同十分钟看两房病人：bullet wound or broken ankle?）；裤腿 L 形裂口；她付诊费、愿付织补费被拒；前手机时代没有 Philomena 号码，血裤步行赴约；Philomena 侧卧床上吹着风读 Jane Austen《Persuasion》毫不生气（dog accident）；楼上、夏多内、tofu chilli stir fry、聊了几小时——midnight 归家悟语「odd things happen all the time」。
facts.anchor: merely an expression of misguided affection due to the dog’s lamentable neurodegenerative disease

facts.fact: Smyg 判他两段都是 boring（容忍他只因救命之恩＋赚大钱）；她的故事备选名 Summer Rain / Summer Hi-jinx，「a tale of yearning, a tale of drama, endless highs and lows」；主角 Lyle：amusingly gorgeous、beautiful smile、cheeky grin；开场口误「a stitch in nine saves time」。
facts.anchor: This one is called ‘The Story of an Amorous Encounter with a Recurring Fireman’

facts.fact: 场景一：去年三月傍晚 5:30 酷热转雷暴、Piedimonte's 十公斤杂货挂车把；车把纸袋崩裂果蔬撒地——陌生帅哥拾钥匙、dulcet 开门、雨中捡果蔬「simple act of heroism」、湿透仍 handsome（mischievous grin + devil-may-care moustache）；壁炉、French Earl Grey、自制樱桃酒心巧克力被他 relish 吃光、借粉绒睡袍＋兔兔拖鞋；住一街区外、消防员＝cat rescuer、名 Lyle；魅力与 lifecompetency 都 out of her league；姓 Towel——「Where do the Towels come from?」「They come from the linen cupboard」笑到不能自已。
facts.anchor: he said in a dulcet tone, Let me open the door for you

facts.fact: 告别与失踪：夜班告辞、「possibly-probably-unlikely」的澳洲 yeah-nah 传统（sick of them、ambivalent、但 some undeniably cute）；送别未遂（door shut in my face）；几小时后想找钥匙——他早把钥匙放牛仔裤兜「for safekeeping」；备胎钥匙救急、不敢打消防局找 Lyle（像有 firefighter fixation 的 nutter）。

场景二：次晚 5:30 他自入其宅、生火坐在同一扶手椅——「fireman 不灭火反而纵火」的反讽＋「在我孤苦渴爱的心里 started a conflagration」；她「manifested my desire, and my desire was incarnated」；三月的反常寒夜 12 度——our weather is going haywire；中名游戏：猜中得 200 刀（Randolph/Rex/Reuben/Reynard；如厕时翻钱包驾照见首字母 B——Beaumont/Beauregard/Beausouris 皆不中）；涂趾甲指甲口红问「Do you want to kiss my ruby-red lips?」→「Not particularly, as he had to go and save lives」→「Save cats more likely...You're not a heart surgeon」；再吃闭门羹→封号 the Shifty Firey / Mr Evasiveness personified。
facts.anchor: He had let himself into my house and lit a fire … Ironic, huh?

facts.fact: 场景三（周五）：她跑步回来他已在、calm and centred almost spiritual；主动摊牌求欢（canoodling/hanky-panky/jiggy-jiggy/trip the light fantastic）→「Let's not rush things – we have all the time in the world」；消防车谜语（four men can't fit under the bonnet）与「A love match」；指控 false pretences → 他自辩「simple, uncomplicated Aussie boy」＋监控式告白（Edinburgh Gardens 四点半到五点半、terrace 独居、无宠物、I know you're lonely）→ She momentarily stumped「He did know me」；判词 kooky but kind, quirky but thoughtful＋damn fine chocolate maker＋cherry pie（someday soon or else never）；谚语对轰（fire servant/master、stitch in time、fire a day keeps the bank manager happy）；十分钟禅坐、Names don't matter、goal-centred 拒绝、Maybe-possibly-unlikely、girlfriend「Could have」、三警告（own way / frac to bunt=back to front / super-smart but naïve）→「you crossed the Rubicon」→pet fireman→rom-con→rom-com（it takes two to rom-com）→20 人友达上限→roll in the hay→「Not tonight, Josephine」→Bellarine Peninsula 冲浪→「I will – for the cherry pie」。
facts.anchor: but how about we have a bout of canoodling followed by hanky-panky and some jiggy-jiggy locomotion

facts.fact: 问答与收尾：favourite movie Some Like It Hot / TV Twin Peaks / Fleet Foxes / 书 Catch-22（ex 的 parting gift、平时不读书——太忙 putting out spot fires）；Smyg 父母青春期后放养（mum 令她 work on personality——她不是 great beauty）、Vic Market 卖水果→IKEA「fastest allen-key twirler in the Wild West」、被讥 unloved waif；pizza call-out（siren 去而缓归、全车吃披萨）；六点半变 pumpkin；Barwon Heads 腐鲸＝漏气橡皮玩具（照片示众，All of God's creatures are beautiful，他自称 pantheist）；前消防员男友 Rory 昆士兰洪水中 tinny 救美、船上行房、上晚间新闻；三晚休＋4am 起＋38 度；素食千层面被拒（too long）——滴答声＝my biological clock；驾照其实被她埋在沙发缝（诱他下周再来）；中名 Brandon（Brand-on Towel 梗，Kinda lame, yes）；她的爱情全部师承 Seinfeld+Friends（与父母一起 religiously 看）；告别吻＝maiden aunt 式脸颊 peck——pleased-annoyed-frustrated；周一再会（time is a flat circle / What goes around, comes around / See you round like a rissole）；「Do you wanna make a baby?」→Not tonight, Josephine；「Did you get the pathos?」；她自白：话多如火山熔岩、I contain multitudes（venerable poet）；fabula interruptus——六场两幕未完；Heller 访谈：享受写作因其难——Smyg：I don't enjoy writing. It's a burden；散场去寻 Martin 再战 verbal pugilism 或找 random 开聊。
